portrait.about: Grace Hopper's portrait (public domain, examples/*/grace_hopper.jpg), centred on a grey 640x360 frame

steps.name: starts on WebGPU
steps.check: (() => { const b = window.bezierPiano.backend(); return { fail: b !== 'tract · WebGPU' && `backend is ${b}`, info: b }; })()

steps.name: tracks camera frames on WebGPU
steps.check: (() => { const ms = window.bezierPiano.inferenceMs(), fps = window.bezierPiano.fps(); return { fail: !(ms > 0 && fps > 0) && `inference ${ms} ms, ${fps} fps`, info: `${ms.toFixed(1)} ms median inference, ${document.getElementById('stats').textContent}` }; })()

steps.name: a pluck plays a note
steps.check: (() => { const before = window.bezierPiano.notes(); window.bezierPiano.pluckCenter(); const a = window.bezierPiano.audio(); return { fail: (window.bezierPiano.notes() !== before + 1 || a.active < 1) && JSON.stringify(a), info: `${JSON.stringify(a)} (no user gesture here, so the context may stay suspended)` }; })()

steps.name: keeps tracking after switching to the CPU
steps.check: (() => { const ms = window.bezierPiano.inferenceMs(); return { fail: !(ms > 0) && `inference ${ms} ms`, info: `${ms.toFixed(1)} ms median inference on the CPU` }; })()
